br.br:
1. A non-retractable wheel-type landing gear for a rotorcraft, comprising:
at least one wheel;
a shock absorber with a length axis and a circumferential direction, the shock absorber being connected to the at least one wheel and comprising:a shock absorber tube; and
a shock absorber rod telescopically mounted to the shock absorber tube;
a mounting arm extending laterally from the shock absorber tube, the mounting arm being integrally formed with the shock absorber tube and adapted for attachment to a first fitting of a rotorcraft; and
a link fixation extending laterally from the shock absorber tube, the link fixation being arranged in the circumferential direction of the shock absorber at an angle in a range from 450 to 1200 with respect to the mounting arm and adapted for connection to a second fitting of the rotorcraft.
2. The non-retractable wheel-type landing gear of The non-retractable wheel-type landing gear of
wherein the link fixation is integrally formed with the shock absorber tube and provided for attachment to a linear link component adapted for linking the shock absorber tube to the second fitting of the rotorcraft.
3. The non-retractable wheel-type landing gear of claim 1, further comprising another link fixation extending laterally from the shock absorber tube, the other link fixation
being arranged in the circumferential direction of the shock absorber at an angle in a range from 450 to 1200 with respect to the link fixation and adapted for connection to a third fitting of the rotorcraft.
4. The non-retractable wheel-type landing gear of The non-retractable wheel-type landing gear of
wherein the other link fixation is integrally formed with the shock absorber tube and provided for attachment to a triangular link component adapted for linking the shock absorber tube to the third fitting of the rotorcraft.
5. The non-retractable wheel-type landing gear of The non-retractable wheel-type landing gear of
wherein the link fixation and the other link fixation span a horizontal plane that is positioned at an angle in a range from 800 to 1000 with respect to the length axis of the shock absorber.
6. The non-retractable wheel-type landing gear of The non-retractable wheel-type landing gear of
wherein the mounting arm and the other link fixation span a vertical plane that is oriented at least approximately perpendicular to the horizontal plane.
7. The non-retractable wheel-type landing gear of The non-retractable wheel-type landing gear of
wherein the shock absorber tube comprises a closed end and an axially opposed open end, wherein the mounting arm is provided close to the closed end, and wherein the link fixation is provided close to the open end.
8. The non-retractable wheel-type landing gear of The non-retractable wheel-type landing gear of
wherein the shock absorber tube comprises a closed end and an axially opposed open end, wherein the mounting arm is provided close to the closed end, and wherein the link fixation and the other link fixation are provided close to the open end.
9. The non-retractable wheel-type landing gear of The non-retractable wheel-type landing gear of
wherein the other link fixation forms a hinge axis that is at least approximately arranged perpendicular to the mounting arm.
